summary_markdown: The discussion focused on building a frequency model for Malaysia, which needs to function across multiple cities (originally modeled for Denmark). A key technical question arose regarding how the system handles data when more than one city is included in the sample. It was clarified that after the last fix, if the selection includes multiple cities, the `city` parameter passed to the frequency function will be empty. Therefore, a separate formula or approach is required to account for this lack of specific city information.
decisions: A separate formula/approach must be developed to handle frequency modeling when the input data contains multiple cities.
action_items: Review and clarify the technical implementation details for multi-city frequency function handling.
